title: HELIX Terminology: Employment Status
description: Current status of a worker's employment relationship with the institution.

codes.definition: Currently employed and in active pay status. Includes workers on regular schedule, reduced schedule, or modified duties.
Employment record exists but individual is not currently in active pay status. Used for seasonal workers between terms or workers awaiting administrative processing.

Approved absence from duties with employment relationship maintained. Includes FMLA, personal leave, medical leave, military leave, sabbatical. Benefits continuation varies by leave type and institutional policy.
Employment relationship ended, either voluntarily (resignation) or involuntarily (dismissal, layoff, reduction in force). Triggers COBRA notification, final pay requirements, and exit processing.
Employment ended through formal retirement. May trigger retiree benefits (if offered), emeritus consideration (for faculty), and pension/403(b) distribution eligibility.
Employment relationship maintained but worker is temporarily removed from duties, with or without pay. Typically pending investigation or disciplinary action.
Worker is deceased. Triggers survivor benefit processing, final pay to estate, life insurance claim, and tax document generation (W-2 to estate/beneficiary).
Temporary unpaid leave initiated by the institution, typically due to budget constraints. Employment relationship maintained; worker retains benefits eligibility in most cases.
